meta.notes: Centralized Ollama model registry. Skills, MCP bridges, and local lanes reference this policy instead of hardcoding model names. Deterministic Yuri functions stay native; local models provide cheap judgment/extraction only.

local.reasoning: PROMOTED 2026-06-13: qwen-local (Qwen3.5-9B-GLM5.1-Distill Q5_K_M) is the default local SLM for primary/utility/code/deep_reasoning — 7/7 role-fit on bounded YURI jobs, ~22.6 tok/s, 6.3GB 100% GPU on the M2 Pro (faster+lighter than gemma; see 02_RESOURCES/research/qwen3.5-9b-glm5.1-distill-local-lane-eval-2026-06-13.md). gemma4:12b-it-qat retained as code_fallback + fallback + the multimodal/`gemma` slots (verified vision path; qwen mmproj not wired). All local dispatch is organ-gated through llm-lane.mjs (qwen-local lane). Autonomous background use via yuri-slm-worker.mjs (ships DISARMED). DeepSeek V4 / Mimo cloud lanes remain separate llm-compat reasoning lanes.

macbook_m2_pro.note: Gemma 4 12B QAT is the only routed local SLM policy. On this 16 GB MacBook it should be treated as a warm, bounded local lane rather than an always-heavy foreground replacement; old Needle/Qwen local choices are retired from llm-compat routing.

rene_5060ti_16gb.note: Jeffrey stack for CGSSCHWEIZ/René. Dual-slot on-demand: jeffrey-vision-local + jeffrey-brain-local — never load both full 12B+ models simultaneously. See 02_RESOURCES/GUIDES/rene-jeffrey-local-stack.md.

environment_override.note: User can override any model via OLLAMA_DEFAULT_MODEL=<model_name>. This file provides documented defaults.

deepseek_v4.canonical_route_note: 2026-06-05 owner decision: canonical deepseek route is the DIRECT api.deepseek.com/v1 (matches the live runner); retired status reverted.

mimo.integration: native Claude Code — sets ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL + ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN at session start; /model mimo-v2.5-pro works natively within that session
mimo.standing_directive: Mimo is first-class equal to Anthropic with the SAME FULL CAPABILITIES as Claude Code — a complete agentic coding peer, NOT advisory/reasoning-only and NOT a bulk/cheap fallback. Always prefer largest context (mimo-v2.5-pro[1m]) and max effort.
mimo.model_selection_in_session: Within ai claude-mimo, use /model <id> to switch — e.g. /model mimo-v2-flash for speed, /model mimo-v2.5[1m] for multimodal 1M
mimo.routing_note: Anthropic Messages API (NOT openai-compatible). Two dispatch surfaces: (1) `ai llm mimo "<prompt>"` routes through llm-lane.mjs's native Anthropic adapter (/v1/messages, SSE); (2) `ai claude-mimo` launches a dedicated isolated Claude Code session with /model mimo-v2.5-pro working natively.
mimo.capability_note: Mimo has the SAME FULL CAPABILITIES as Claude Code — not advisory/reasoning-only, not bulk/cheap-only. `ai claude-mimo` runs the real Claude Code binary, so a Mimo session is a complete agentic peer (full tool loop, coding, file edits) identical to a main Claude session with a different model backend.
recommended_use: full agentic coding sessions (ai claude-mimo) equal to a main Claude session
mimo.session_constraint: One ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL per session — a Mimo session is separate from the main Anthropic session by architecture, NOT by capability. Run Mimo in its own `ai claude-mimo` session.

llm_compat_lanes._comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for live reasoning lanes. NVIDIA NIM lanes (kimi, nemotron) retired 2026-06-10; Mimo added same day. context_window = INPUT cap; max_output = per-reasoning-depth OUTPUT cap. Consumed by llm-lane.mjs. OpenAI-compatible lanes: deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash. Anthropic-compatible lanes: mimo-v2.5-pro[1m], mimo-v2.5[1m], mimo-v2-flash (Messages API + SSE).

deepseek-v4-pro.max_output_source: REPOINTED 2026-06-15 (owner): the `deepseek`/`ds`/`deepseek-v4-pro` lane now routes through Ollama Cloud (deepseek-v4-pro:cloud) via llm-lane.mjs, REPLACING the retired paid api.deepseek.com version. Owner: deepseek-v4-pro is a favourite — powerful, fine for very high complexity + long runs. Output cap PROBED 2026-06-15 via live 400: ollama-cloud caps deepseek-v4-pro:cloud OUTPUT at 65536 (xhigh request 131072 → 400 → memoized 65536, same ceiling as nemotron); model_output_caps clamps to 65536 at dispatch. Input pool still ~1M (deepseek is the only ollama-cloud family delivering true 1M input).

deepseek-v4-flash.max_output_source: REPOINTED 2026-06-15 (owner): the `ds-flash`/`flash`/`deepseek-v4-flash` lane now routes through Ollama Cloud (deepseek-v4-flash:cloud) via llm-lane.mjs, REPLACING the retired paid api.deepseek.com version. Fast tier; output cap PROBED 2026-06-15 via live 400 = 65536 (not 131072); model_output_caps clamps to 65536 at dispatch.

mimo-v2.5-pro[1m].max_output_source: Mimo v2.5-pro declared max_output 131072 (2026-06-10). Standing directive: always use largest context + max effort.

mimo-v2.5[1m].max_output_source: Mimo v2.5 multimodal 1M context. Vision + reasoning.

Context bumped 200K->1M (owner directive 2026-06-19; Z.ai blog confirms 1M max context, 128K max output). max_output tiers left as probe-verified envelope. NOTE: 1M is the model max; if the Anthropic-compat endpoint 400s on a >200K request, a long-context header convention may still be needed (live-probe to confirm).

glm-5-turbo.max_output_source: Z.ai glm-5-turbo = GLM-5 intelligence at TURBO speed. Live-measured ~4s vs glm-5.2 6s / glm-4.7 33s (2026-06-19) — the snappy reactive pick + voice-brain model.

glm-5.1.max_output_source: Z.ai glm-5.1 = GLM-5 flagship, one tier below 5.2.

glm-4.7-flash.max_output_source: Z.ai glm-4.7-flash = Haiku-equiv (opus-fleet 2026-06-22): fast/free GLM-4.7 distill (~89 tok/s, ~1.6s TTFT, 200K ctx) for census/scan/read. Replaces glm-4.5-air in the Haiku slot. Caps approximate; refine via live 400-probe.

glm-4.7-flashx.max_output_source: Z.ai glm-4.7-flashx = Haiku+ concurrency upgrade of glm-4.7-flash (paid, higher throughput ceiling) for wide cheap fan-out. LIVE-PROBE 2026-06-22: id ACCEPTED (no 404) but returns empty_output via the Anthropic-compat endpoint at low+high reasoning — UNVERIFIED, do NOT rely (likely not provisioned on the plan). Working free Haiku lane = glm-4.7-flash. Caps approximate.

glm-4.6v.max_output_source: Z.ai glm-4.6v = vision tier (opus-fleet 2026-06-22): image/screenshot analysis (GLM-5V-Turbo not on subscription). Already the voice-brain screenshot model (yuri-z-brain.py). Context/output conservative pending live probe.

glm-ocr.max_output_source: Z.ai glm-ocr = OCR/document-extraction specialist (opus-fleet 2026-06-22): OmniDocBench-leading, ~$0.03/M. LIVE-PROBE 2026-06-22: id ACCEPTED but a text-only ping returns empty_output — OCR needs an image payload the text lane does not send; UNVERIFIED via the text path, wire when an image-bearing call path exists. Context/output conservative.

qwen-local.max_output_source: Qwen3.5-9B-GLM5.1-Distill Q5_K_M (6.47GB, 100% GPU on M2 Pro). num_ctx capped at context_window to keep weights+KV under the 10GB Metal working-set policy. Curated local lane: dispatched through llm-lane.mjs so it fires coreOnDispatch (energy ΔU + recall) + coreOnResult (evidence + advisory pulse) + executeTool safety-core gating, identical governance to cloud lanes. Loadout defaults to --light (a 9B can't carry the full 675-line spine in 16k ctx).

gemma-local.max_output_source: Gemma 4 12B QAT (7.15GB, 100% GPU on M2 Pro) — the incumbent local SLM, promoted to a curated llm_compat lane so it runs through the SAME governed dispatch as cloud + qwen-local instead of the thin ollama-lane.mjs bypass. Single-lane sequential per the gemma-lanes-strictly-sequential lock.

vibethinker-local.max_output_source: VibeThinker-3B (WeiboAI, MIT, Qwen2.5-Coder-3B base) Q4_K_M, 1.9GB — DISARMED/ADVISORY local trade-analysis reasoning lane (owner 2026-06-17; overseer-verified ~43 tok/s on the M2 Pro, loads clean, does not choke). DEEP long-chain-of-thought reasoner: emits a <think>...</think> block (~21s+) it CANNOT be told to skip, so num_predict is floored at 2560 (off) to fit the CoT + the answer; strip the <think> block for the terse verdict. The CoT is the asset for quantitative trade reasoning. Invoke with --no-tools --light (a 3B cannot carry the full YURI spine in 16k ctx). ADVISORY ONLY — never sizes trades, not wired into any config-write/sizing/overseer path; available for explicit analysis calls.

gemma4-coder-local.max_output_source: gemma-4-12B-coder-fable5-composer2.5 (Apache-2.0, base google/gemma-4-12B-it, fine-tuned on verifiable Python coding data with chain-of-thought) Q4_K_M 7.38GB — DISARMED/ADVISORY local trade-analysis reasoning lane (owner 2026-06-18). A 12B CODING model with native thinking mode (enable_thinking; emits a reasoning block) — tests whether coding-CoT transfers to quantitative trade reasoning vs the 3B vibethinker-local. num_ctx capped at 16384 (card advertises 256K but the M2 Pro Metal working-set policy caps it like gemma-local; weights 7.38GB + KV must stay under the 10GB cap). llm-lane forces temperature 0 (deterministic analysis) vs the card's creative temp 1.0 — fine for analysis. Invoke with --no-tools --light (a 12B cannot carry the full YURI spine). ADVISORY ONLY — never sizes trades, not wired into any config-write/sizing/overseer path. Card notes reduced safety guardrails (coding focus) — irrelevant for trade-data analysis.

jeffrey-vision-local.max_output_source: Jeffrey vision slot for René (5060 Ti 16GB). Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking ~6GB Q4 + image tokens. Always-on CoT — budget long max_output for CAD/Blender/screenshot reasoning. Pair with jeffrey-brain-local on-demand (not simultaneous). Clicky OLLAMA_VISION_MODEL target.

jeffrey-brain-local.max_output_source: Jeffrey command brain for René. Qwen3-14B ~9GB Q4 with /think toggle for tool orchestration + multi-step holster/CAD planning. Fallback: gemma4-coder-local (Fable CoT). Clicky OLLAMA_TEXT_MODEL target. YURI_LOCAL_MAX_CONCURRENCY=1.

ollama-cloud.max_output_source: Ollama Cloud (ollama.com /api/chat, Bearer OLLAMA_API_KEY) — FIRST-CLASS PEER lane equal to deepseek/mimo: routed through llm-lane.mjs so it gets the full YURI NANO SWARM loadout + read/grep/search/xref/bash/write/edit toolset + coreOnDispatch/coreOnResult governance, NOT the thin ollama-lane.mjs path. Cloud model IDs carry a :cloud suffix (live-verified 2026-06-14). Default minimax-m3:cloud is overridable per call with --model. (GLM REMOVED from this lane 2026-06-19 (owner) — GLM routes ONLY through the z-ai lanes glm-5.2/glm-5-turbo/glm-4.7/glm-4.5-air to avoid the api.z.ai-vs-ollama naming mismatch.) Pro plan = 3 concurrent → fan out 3 `ollama-cloud --model <X>:cloud` calls for a cross-family peer nano-swarm. Owner-selected build roster (research ollama-cloud-model-selection-2026-06-14.md): nemotron-3-ultra:cloud, minimax-m3:cloud, kimi-k2.7-code:cloud (added 2026-06-14, live-verified in catalog; ollama-native full-Claude-Code bridge: `ollama launch claude --model kimi-k2.7-code:cloud`), gemma4:31b-cloud (added 2026-06-14, owner-selected; catalog lists base `gemma4:31b`, cloud variant addressed via the `-cloud` suffix per `ollama run gemma4:31b-cloud`; live-smoke-verified), deepseek-v4-pro:cloud + deepseek-v4-flash:cloud (added 2026-06-15, owner — these REPLACE the retired paid api.deepseek.com lane; the `deepseek`/`ds`/`ds-flash` aliases now resolve to Ollama Cloud; full 5-model blast roster = nemotron-3-ultra + minimax-m3 + kimi-k2.7-code + deepseek-v4-pro + deepseek-v4-flash, all usable for very high complexity + long runs). CAPABILITY (owner 2026-06-14, LIVE-VERIFIED via 400 errors): context pool up to 1M (input). CONTEXT NUANCE (owner 2026-06-15): deepseek-v4-pro:cloud / deepseek-v4-flash:cloud appear to be the ONLY ollama-cloud models that actually deliver the full 1M INPUT context — the others (minimax-m3, nemotron-3-ultra, kimi-k2.7-code) advertise 1M natively at their own providers but Ollama appears to cap them earlier; treat non-deepseek 1M as UNVERIFIED (real per-model input cap discovered+memoized on 400). OUTPUT caps differ per model: minimax-m3 = 131072 (xhigh), nemotron-3-ultra = 65536. 250k was an over-estimate. So xhigh=131072 (minimax real max). RESOLVED 2026-06-14 (the per-model follow-up): per-model output caps now expressed in `model_output_caps` above — llm-lane clamps maxTokens to the model's cap at dispatch so nemotron runs at 65536 from turn 1 (no manual --reasoning flag), AND postChatOllamaCloud memoizes any cap discovered via a 400 across the whole tool-loop (kills the per-turn re-discovery 400 that made nemotron look stuck). Unknown models (e.g. kimi-k2.7-code, cap not yet probed) fall through to discovery+memo.
